verses.kjv: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.modern: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things. He would be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes. He would be killed, and after three days He would rise again.

verses.kjv: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.modern: He spoke plainly about this. Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

verses.kjv: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
verses.modern: Jesus turned and looked at His disciples, then rebuked Peter. He said, "Get behind Me, Satan! You do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men."

verses.kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.modern: He called the crowd to Him along with His disciples and said, "Whoever wants to come after Me must deny himself, take up His cross, and follow Me."

verses.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
verses.modern: Whoever wants to save his life will lose it. But whoever loses his life for My sake and the gospel's will save it.

verses.kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verses.modern: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world yet forfeit his soul?

verses.kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.modern: What can a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.modern: Whoever is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation — the Son of Man will be ashamed of Him when He comes in His Father's glory with the holy angels.

chapters.summary: Jesus feeds four thousand people with seven loaves, refuses the Pharisees' demand for a sign, and heals a blind man at Bethsaida. Peter confesses that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus foretells His suffering, death, and resurrection, calling on His followers to take up their cross.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Truly I tell You, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God come with power."

verses.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
verses.modern: After six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John with him. He led them up a high mountain alone by themselves. He was transfigured before them.

verses.kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
verses.modern: His clothes became dazzling white — whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.

verses.kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.modern: Elijah appeared to them with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.modern: Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters — one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

verses.kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.modern: He did not know what to say, for they were terrified.

verses.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.modern: Then a cloud came and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: "This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him."

verses.kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.modern: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them anymore except Jesus.

verses.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.modern: As they came down the mountain, He commanded them to tell no one what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

verses.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.modern: They kept the matter to themselves, asking each other what "rising from the dead" meant.

verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.modern: They asked Him, "Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"

verses.kjv: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Elijah does come first and restores all things. But how is it written of the Son of Man that He must suffer many things and be treated with contempt?"

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.modern: "Truly I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did to him whatever they pleased, just as it is written about him."

verses.kjv: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.modern: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the scribes arguing with them.

verses.kjv: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
verses.modern: As soon as the crowd saw Jesus, they were greatly amazed and ran to greet Him.

verses.kjv: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
verses.modern: He asked the scribes, "What are You arguing with them about?"

verses.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.modern: A man in the crowd answered, "Master, I brought you my son, who has a spirit that makes Him mute."

verses.kjv: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
verses.modern: "Wherever it takes hold of Him, it throws Him down. He foams at the mouth, gnashes His teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."

verses.kjv: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.modern: He answered, "O faithless generation, how long shall I be with You? How long shall I put up with You? Bring the boy to Me."

verses.kjv: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.modern: They brought the boy to him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

verses.kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.modern: Jesus asked His father, "How long has this been happening to Him?" "From childhood," He said.

verses.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.modern: "It has often thrown Him into fire and into water to kill Him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us."

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "If You can believe — all things are possible to the one who believes."

verses.kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.modern: The father of the child cried out at once, "Lord, I believe — help my unbelief!"

verses.kjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.modern: When Jesus saw that the crowd was running to see what was happening, He rebuked the unclean spirit. He said, "You mute and deaf spirit, I command You — come out of Him and never enter Him again."

verses.kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.modern: The spirit cried out, convulsed the boy violently, and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, "He is dead."

verses.kjv: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.modern: But Jesus took Him by the hand and lifted Him up, and He stood up.

verses.kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.modern: After Jesus went indoors, His disciples asked Him privately, "Why could we not drive it out?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.modern: He said to them, "This kind can come out by nothing except prayer and fasting."

verses.kjv: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
verses.modern: They left that place and passed through Galilee. He did not want anyone to know where they were.

verses.kjv: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.modern: He was teaching His disciples, telling them, "The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after three days He will rise."

verses.kjv: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.modern: They did not understand what He meant and were afraid to ask Him about it.

verses.kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.modern: They came to Capernaum. When He was in the house, He asked them, "What were You arguing about on the road?"

verses.kjv: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
verses.modern: They were silent, because on the road they had argued about who was the greatest.

verses.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.modern: He sat down, called the twelve, and said to them, "If anyone wants to be first, he must be last of all and servant of all."

verses.kjv: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.modern: He took a little child and set Him in the middle of them. Taking the child in his arms, he said to them,

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.modern: "Whoever receives one of these little children in My name receives Me. Whoever receives Me receives not Me but the One who sent Me."

verses.kjv: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.modern: John said to him, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name and we told Him to stop, because He was not one of us."

verses.kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Do not stop Him. No one who does a miracle in My name can soon speak evil of Me."

verses.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.modern: Whoever is not against us is for us.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, truly I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, whoever gives you a cup of water to drink because you belong to Christ will certainly not lose His reward.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.modern: If anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to sin, it would be better for Him to have a large millstone hung around His neck and to be thrown into the sea.

verses.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.modern: If Your hand causes You to sin, cut it off. It is better to enter life maimed than to go into hell with two hands — into the fire that never goes out.

verses.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.modern: where their worm does not die and the fire is not quenched.

verses.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.modern: If Your foot causes You to sin, cut it off. It is better to enter life lame than to be thrown into hell with two feet — into the fire that never goes out.

verses.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.modern: where their worm does not die and the fire is not quenched.

verses.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
verses.modern: If Your eye causes You to sin, pluck it out. It is better to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to be thrown into hell with two eyes,

verses.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.modern: where their worm does not die and the fire is not quenched.

verses.kjv: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
verses.modern: Everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be salted with salt.

verses.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
verses.modern: Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can You make it salty again? Have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another.

chapters.summary: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John on a high mountain, and Moses and Elijah appear with Him. He casts out a demon the disciples could not, foretells His death and resurrection a second time, and teaches that whoever would be greatest must be servant of all.

verses.kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.modern: Jesus left there and went into the region of Judaea and beyond the Jordan. Crowds gathered around Him again, and as was His custom, He taught them.

verses.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
verses.modern: Some Pharisees came to Him and asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?" They were testing him.

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.modern: He answered them, "What did Moses command you?"

verses.kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
verses.modern: They said, "Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Moses wrote this commandment for you because of the hardness of Your hearts."

verses.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.modern: But from the beginning of creation God made them male and female.

verses.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.modern: For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and hold fast to his wife,

verses.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.modern: and the two shall become one flesh. So they are no longer two but one flesh.

verses.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.modern: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.

verses.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
verses.modern: In the house His disciples asked Him again about this.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her."

verses.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.modern: And if she divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.

verses.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
verses.modern: People were bringing little children to Jesus for Him to touch them. The disciples rebuked those who brought them.

verses.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: When Jesus saw this, He was indignant. He said to them, "Let the little children come to Me. Do not stop them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these."

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.

verses.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.modern: He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.

verses.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.modern: As He was going out on the road, a man ran up and knelt before him. He asked, "Good Master, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Why do You call Me good? No one is good except God alone."

verses.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.modern: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not give false testimony, do not defraud, honor Your father and mother.

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.modern: The man replied, "Master, all these I have kept since I was young."

verses.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verses.modern: Jesus looked at Him and loved Him. He said, "One thing You lack. Go, sell everything You have and give to the poor, and You will have treasure in heaven. Then come, take up Your cross, and follow Me."

verses.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
verses.modern: The man's face fell at these words. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.

verses.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.modern: Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.modern: The disciples were amazed at His words. Jesus said again, "Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the kingdom of God!"

verses.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
verses.modern: They were even more amazed and said to one another, "Who then can be saved?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.modern: Jesus looked at them and said, "With men it is impossible, but not with God. All things are possible with God."

verses.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
verses.modern: Peter said to him, "We have left everything to follow You."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, Jesus answered, there is no one who has left house, brothers, sisters, father, mother, wife, children, or lands for My sake and for the gospel's sake,

verses.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.modern: who will not receive a hundred times as much in this present age — houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and lands, along with persecutions — and in the age to come, eternal life.

verses.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.modern: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.

verses.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
verses.modern: They were on the road going up to Jerusalem. Jesus walked ahead of them. The disciples were amazed and those following were afraid. He took the twelve aside again and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him.

verses.kjv: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
verses.modern: "We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn Him to death and hand Him over to the Gentiles."

verses.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.modern: "They will mock Him, spit on Him, flog Him, and kill Him. After three days He will rise again."

verses.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
verses.modern: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. "Master," they said, "we want You to do whatever we ask."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
verses.modern: He said to them, "What do You want Me to do for You?"

verses.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
verses.modern: They said, "Grant us to sit, one on Your right and one on Your left, in Your glory."

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "You do not know what You are asking. Can You drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?"

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
verses.modern: "We can," they answered. Jesus said to them, "You will drink the cup I drink and You will be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with."

verses.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
verses.modern: "But to sit on My right or left is not Mine to give. It belongs to those for whom it has been prepared."

verses.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
verses.modern: When the other ten heard this, they were indignant at James and John.

verses.kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
verses.modern: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that those who are considered rulers over the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them."

verses.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
verses.modern: It shall not be so among You. Whoever wants to be great among you must be your servant.

verses.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
verses.modern: Whoever wants to be first among you must be slave of all.

verses.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.modern: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.

verses.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.modern: They came to Jericho. As Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho with a large crowd, blind Bartimaeus the son of Timaeus was sitting by the roadside begging.

verses.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.modern: When He heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, He began to cry out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.modern: Many told him to be quiet, but he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.modern: Jesus stopped and said, "Call Him." They called the blind man, saying, "Take courage! Get up — He is calling You."

verses.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.modern: He threw off His cloak, jumped up, and came to Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "What do You want Me to do for You?" The blind man said, "Lord, that I might receive my sight."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Go. Your faith has made You well." At once He received His sight and followed Jesus along the road.

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches on divorce and blesses little children brought to Him. A rich young ruler refuses to sell all and follow Him, and Jesus tells His disciples that with God all things are possible. He foretells His death a third time, rebukes the ambition of James and John, and heals blind Bartimaeus near Jericho.

verses.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
verses.modern: As they approached Jerusalem, near Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, He sent out two of His disciples.

verses.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Go into the village ahead of You. As soon as You enter it, You will find a colt tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here."

verses.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
verses.modern: "If anyone asks you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.'"

verses.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
verses.modern: They went and found the colt tied outside in the street at a doorway. They untied it.

verses.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.modern: Some people standing there asked, "What are You doing, untying that colt?"

verses.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
verses.modern: They answered as Jesus had told them, and the people let them go.

verses.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verses.modern: They brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks on it, and He sat on it.

verses.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.modern: Many people spread their cloaks on the road. Others spread branches they had cut from the fields.

verses.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.modern: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"

verses.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.modern: "Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!"

verses.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.modern: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went to the temple. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.

verses.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
verses.modern: The next day, when they came from Bethany, He was hungry.

verses.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
verses.modern: Seeing a fig tree in the distance with leaves on it, He went to see if it had any fruit. When He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
verses.modern: Jesus said to it, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again." And his disciples heard this.

verses.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
verses.modern: They came to Jerusalem. Jesus entered the temple and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

verses.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
verses.modern: He would not allow anyone to carry goods through the temple courts.

verses.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.modern: He was teaching them and said, "Is it not written: 'My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations'? But You have made it a den of thieves."

verses.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
verses.modern: The chief priests and scribes heard this and began to look for a way to destroy Him. They feared Him, because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching.

verses.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
verses.modern: When evening came, they went out of the city.

verses.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.modern: In the morning as they walked along, they saw that the fig tree had withered from its roots.

verses.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.modern: Peter remembered and said to him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree You cursed has withered."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Have faith in God."

verses.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, whoever says to this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' and does not doubt in His heart but believes that what He says will happen — it will be done for Him.

verses.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verses.modern: Therefore I tell You, whatever You ask for in prayer, believe that You have received it, and it will be Yours.

verses.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.modern: When You stand praying, forgive whatever You have against anyone, so that your Father in heaven may also forgive You Your sins.

verses.kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
verses.modern: But if You do not forgive, neither will Your Father in heaven forgive Your sins.

verses.kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
verses.modern: They came again to Jerusalem. While He was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to Him.

verses.kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.modern: They asked, "By what authority are You doing these things? Who gave You this authority?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "I will ask You one question. Answer Me and I will tell You by what authority I do these things."

verses.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
verses.modern: "Was the baptism of John from heaven or from men? Answer Me."

verses.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.modern: They argued among themselves: "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will ask, 'Then why did You not believe Him?'"

verses.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
verses.modern: "But if we say, 'From men' —" they feared the people, for everyone regarded John as truly a prophet.

verses.kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.modern: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know." Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell You by what authority I do these things."

chapters.summary: Jesus enters Jerusalem riding on a colt as the crowds cry 'Hosanna' and spread their garments in the road. He drives out the money changers from the temple, curses a barren fig tree that withers by the next morning, and teaches about faith and prayer.

verses.kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.modern: He began to speak to them in parables. "A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for a winepress, and built a watchtower. He rented it to farmers and went away on a journey."

verses.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.modern: At harvest time He sent a servant to the farmers to collect some of the fruit of the vineyard from them.

verses.kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.modern: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
verses.modern: He sent another servant to them. They struck Him on the head and treated Him shamefully.

verses.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.modern: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others — they beat some and killed others.

verses.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.modern: He had one more to send — a beloved son. He sent Him last of all, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

verses.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
verses.modern: But those farmers said to one another, 'This is the heir. Come, let us kill Him and the inheritance will be ours.'

verses.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.modern: They took Him, killed Him, and threw Him out of the vineyard.

verses.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.modern: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers and give the vineyard to others.

verses.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.modern: Have You not read this scripture: 'The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.'

verses.kjv: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.modern: 'This is the Lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?"

verses.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.modern: They wanted to arrest Him but were afraid of the crowd, because they understood He had spoken the parable against them. So they left Him and went away.

verses.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
verses.modern: They sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to catch Him in His words.

verses.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.modern: They came and said to Him, "Master, we know that You are truthful and show no partiality to anyone. You do not look at the outward appearance of men but teach the way of God truthfully. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

verses.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
verses.modern: "Should we pay or not?" Knowing their hypocrisy, He said to them, "Why are You testing Me? Bring Me a denarius so I can look at it."

verses.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.modern: They brought one. He asked, "Whose image and inscription is this?" "Caesar's," they said.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's." They were amazed at Him.

verses.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.modern: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him and asked,

verses.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.modern: "Master, Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must take the widow and raise up offspring for his brother."

verses.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.modern: There were seven brothers. The first one took a wife and died without leaving children.

verses.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.modern: The second one married the widow and also died without leaving children. The third did the same.

verses.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.modern: In fact, none of the seven left children. Last of all, the woman died too.

verses.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.modern: At the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Is this not the reason You are wrong — that You do not know the scriptures or the power of God?"

verses.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.modern: When the dead rise, they neither marry nor are given in marriage. They are like the angels in heaven.

verses.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.modern: As for the dead rising — have you not read in the book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to Him, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'?

verses.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.modern: He is not the God of the dead but of the living. You are badly mistaken."

verses.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.modern: One of the scribes came and heard them arguing. When He noticed that Jesus had given them a good answer, He asked Him, "Which is the first commandment of all?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "The first is: 'Hear, O Israel — the Lord our God is one Lord.'"

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.modern: "'You shall love the Lord Your God with all Your heart, and with all Your soul, and with all Your mind, and with all Your strength.' This is the first commandment."

verses.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.modern: "The second is this: 'You shall love Your neighbor as Yourself.' There is no other commandment greater than these."

verses.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.modern: The scribe said to him, "Well said, Master. You have spoken the truth — that He is one and there is no other besides Him."

verses.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.modern: "To love Him with all the heart, all the understanding, and all the strength, and to love one's neighbor as oneself — that is worth more than all burnt offerings and sacrifices."

verses.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.modern: When Jesus saw that He answered wisely, He said to Him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." After that no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
verses.modern: While He was teaching in the temple, Jesus said, "How can the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?"

verses.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.modern: David himself, speaking by the Holy Ghost, said: 'The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand, until I make Your enemies Your footstool.'

verses.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.modern: David himself calls him 'Lord.' How then can he be his son?" The large crowd listened to Him with delight.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.modern: In His teaching He said, "Watch out for the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes and receive greetings in the marketplaces."

verses.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.modern: "They love the best seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at feasts."

verses.kjv: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.modern: "They devour widows' houses and for a show make long prayers. These men will receive greater damnation."

verses.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.modern: Jesus sat across from the treasury and watched the crowd putting money into it. Many rich people put in large amounts.

verses.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.modern: But a poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, worth only a fraction of a penny.

verses.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.modern: He called His disciples together and said, "Truly I tell You, this poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others."

verses.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.modern: "They all gave out of their wealth. But she, out of her poverty, put in everything — all she had to live on."

chapters.summary: Jesus tells the parable of the wicked husbandmen and silences the Pharisees, Herodians, and Sadducees who try to trap Him with questions about tribute, the resurrection, and the greatest commandment. He warns against the scribes and commends a poor widow who casts two mites into the treasury.

verses.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.modern: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, "Master, look — what stones and what buildings!"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Do You see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left on another — every one will be thrown down."

verses.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.modern: As He was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

verses.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.modern: "Tell us, when will these things happen? What will be the sign that all these things are about to be fulfilled?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.modern: Jesus began to say to them, "Watch out that no one deceives you."

verses.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.modern: "Many will come in My name, saying, 'I am Christ,' and will deceive many."

verses.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.modern: "When You hear of wars and reports of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is not yet."

verses.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.modern: "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines and troubles. These are the beginnings of sorrows."

verses.kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.modern: "You must watch out for yourselves. They will hand You over to the courts. You will be beaten in the synagogues. You will stand before governors and kings for My sake, as a testimony to them."

verses.kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.modern: "The gospel must first be proclaimed to all nations."

verses.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: "When they arrest You and hand You over, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Say whatever is given You in that hour, for it is not You who speak but the Holy Ghost."

verses.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.modern: "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father His child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death."

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.modern: "You will be hated by everyone because of My name. But the one who stands firm to the end will be saved."

verses.kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.modern: "When you see the abomination of desolation spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not — let the reader understand — then those who are in Judaea should flee to the mountains."

verses.kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.modern: "Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out."

verses.kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.modern: "Let no one in the field go back to get his cloak."

verses.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.modern: "How terrible it will be in those days for pregnant women and for nursing mothers!"

verses.kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.modern: "Pray that your flight will not take place in winter."

verses.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.modern: "For in those days there will be such distress as has not been seen from the beginning of God's creation until now, and will never be seen again."

verses.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.modern: "If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short."

verses.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.modern: "At that time if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or 'Look, there He is!' — do not believe it."

verses.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.modern: "For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and miracles to deceive, if possible, even the elect."

verses.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.modern: "But watch out — I have told You everything ahead of time."

verses.kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.modern: "But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light."

verses.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.modern: "The stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken."

verses.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.modern: "Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory."

verses.kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.modern: "He will send out His angels and gather His elect from the four winds, from the farthest end of the earth to the farthest end of heaven."

verses.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.modern: "Now learn this lesson from the fig tree. When its branch becomes tender and puts out leaves, You know that summer is near."

verses.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.modern: "In the same way, when You see these things happening, know that it is near — right at the door."

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.modern: "Truly I tell You, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened."

verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.modern: "Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away."

verses.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.modern: "But about that day or hour no one knows — not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father."

verses.kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.modern: "Watch out! Stay alert and pray. You do not know when that time will come."

verses.kjv: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.modern: "It is like a man going on a journey. He leaves his house and puts His servants in charge, each with their assigned task. He commands the doorkeeper to keep watch."

verses.kjv: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.modern: "Therefore keep watch — for You do not know when the master of the house will come: whether in the evening, at midnight, at the crow of the rooster, or in the morning."

verses.kjv: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.modern: "If He comes suddenly, do not let Him find You sleeping."

verses.kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.modern: "What I say to You I say to everyone: Watch!"

chapters.summary: Jesus foretells the destruction of the temple and the signs of the end, including wars, earthquakes, famines, and false Christs. He describes His coming in the clouds with great power and glory and warns His disciples to watch, for no one knows the day or the hour.

verses.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
verses.modern: The Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away. The chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to arrest Jesus by stealth and kill Him.

verses.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.modern: "But not during the feast," they said, "or the people may riot."

verses.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
verses.modern: While Jesus was in Bethany, reclining at table in the house of Simon the leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on His head.

verses.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.modern: Some who were there were indignant and said to each other, "Why this waste of perfume?"

verses.kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.modern: "It could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor." They rebuked her harshly.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Leave her alone. Why are You bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to Me."

verses.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.modern: "The poor You will always have with You, and You can help them whenever You wish. But You will not always have Me."

verses.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.modern: "She did what she could. She anointed My body beforehand for burial."

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.modern: "Truly I tell You, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the whole world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her."

verses.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.modern: Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.

verses.kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.modern: When they heard this they were delighted and promised to give him money. So Judas watched for a good opportunity to hand him over.

verses.kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.modern: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was sacrificed, His disciples asked Him, "Where do You want us to go and prepare for You to eat the Passover?"

verses.kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.modern: He sent two of His disciples and said to them, "Go into the city. A man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him."

verses.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.modern: "Wherever he enters, tell the owner of the house, 'The Master says: Where is My guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?'"

verses.kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.modern: "He will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there."

verses.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.modern: The disciples left and went into the city. They found things just as He had told them and prepared the Passover.

verses.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.modern: When evening came, He arrived with the twelve.

verses.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.modern: While they were reclining and eating, Jesus said, "Truly I tell You, one of You will betray Me — one who is eating with Me."

verses.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
verses.modern: They were grieved and began to say to Him one by one, "Is it I?" And another said, "Is it I?"

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.modern: He said to them, "It is one of the twelve — one who dips bread into the bowl with Me."

verses.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.modern: "The Son of Man goes as it is written about Him. But woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had never been born."

verses.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.modern: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks, and broke it. He gave it to them and said, "Take — this is My body."

verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.modern: Then He took a cup, and when He had given thanks He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.modern: He said to them, "This is My blood of the new testament, which is shed for many."

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: "Truly I tell You, I will not drink again of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God."

verses.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.modern: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "You will all fall away because of Me this night. For it is written: 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'"

verses.kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.modern: "But after I am raised up, I will go before You into Galilee."

verses.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.modern: Peter said to him, "Even if everyone falls away, I will not."

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Truly I tell You, today — this very night — before the rooster crows twice, You will deny Me three times."

verses.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.modern: But Peter insisted all the more, "Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You." All the others said the same.

verses.kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.modern: They came to a place called Gethsemane. He said to His disciples, "Sit here while I pray."

verses.kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.modern: He took Peter, James, and John with him. He began to be deeply distressed and troubled.

verses.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.modern: He said to them, "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch."

verses.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.modern: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from Him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.modern: He said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible for You. Take this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You will."

verses.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.modern: He came back and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, "Simon, are you asleep? Could you not keep watch for one hour?"

verses.kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
verses.modern: "Watch and pray so that you do not enter into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."

verses.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.modern: He went away again and prayed, saying the same words.

verses.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.modern: When He came back, He again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to Him.

verses.kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.modern: He came back a third time and said to them, "Are You still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. The Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners."

verses.kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.modern: "Get up, let us go. Look — My betrayer is near."

verses.kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.modern: At once, while He was still speaking, Judas — one of the twelve — arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

verses.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.modern: The betrayer had given them a signal: "The man I kiss is the one. Arrest him and lead him away securely."

verses.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.modern: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Rabbi, Rabbi!" and kissed him.

verses.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.modern: The men seized Jesus and arrested Him.

verses.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.modern: One of those standing nearby drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Have You come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as though I were a robber?"

verses.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.modern: "Every day I was with You in the temple teaching, and You did not arrest Me. But the scriptures must be fulfilled."

verses.kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.modern: Then all His disciples left Him and fled.

verses.kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.modern: A young man was following Him, wearing nothing but a linen cloth over His body. They grabbed Him,

verses.kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.modern: but He left the linen cloth and ran away naked.

verses.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.modern: They led Jesus to the high priest. All the chief priests, elders, and scribes gathered together.

verses.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.modern: Peter followed Jesus at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. He sat with the guards and warmed Himself at the fire.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.modern: The chief priests and the whole council were looking for testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death. But they found none.

verses.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.modern: Many gave false testimony against Him, but their testimony did not agree.

verses.kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.modern: Some stood up and gave this false testimony against Him:

verses.kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.modern: "We heard Him say, 'I will destroy this temple made with hands and in three days build another not made with hands.'"

verses.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.modern: But even on this point their testimony did not agree.

verses.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.modern: Then the high priest stood up in the middle and asked Jesus, "Do You have no answer? What is this testimony these men are bringing against You?"

verses.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.modern: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. The high priest asked Him again, "Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "I am. And You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven."

verses.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.modern: The high priest tore His clothes. "What further need do we have of witnesses?" he said.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.modern: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do You think?" They all condemned Him as deserving death.

verses.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.modern: Some began to spit on Him. They blindfolded Him and struck Him, saying, "Prophesy!" The guards also took Him and beat Him.

verses.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.modern: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.

verses.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.modern: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, "You also were with Jesus of Nazareth."

verses.kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.modern: But He denied it. "I don't know or understand what You're talking about," he said. He went out into the entrance, and a rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
verses.modern: The servant girl saw him there and again said to those standing nearby, "This man is one of them."

verses.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
verses.modern: He denied it again. A little later those standing there said to Peter, "Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."

verses.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.modern: He began to call down curses, and he swore, "I do not know this man you are talking about."

verses.kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
verses.modern: At once a rooster crowed a second time. Peter remembered how Jesus had said to Him, "Before the rooster crows twice, You will deny Me three times." He broke down and wept.

chapters.summary: A woman anoints Jesus with costly spikenard at Bethany, and Judas agrees to betray Him. Jesus observes the Last Supper, prays in the Garden of Gethsemane, is betrayed by Judas, arrested, tried before the high priest, and denied three times by Peter.

verses.kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
verses.modern: Very early in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, reached a decision. They bound Jesus, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate.

verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
verses.modern: Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" Jesus answered, "You have said so."

verses.kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.modern: The chief priests accused Him of many things, but He answered nothing.

verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.modern: Pilate asked him again, "Do you have no answer? See how many things they are accusing You of."

verses.kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.modern: But Jesus still answered nothing, so that Pilate was amazed.

verses.kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.modern: Now at the feast He was accustomed to release to them one prisoner — whichever one they asked for.

verses.kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
verses.modern: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the rebels who had committed murder during the uprising.
