verses.kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
verses.modern: The crowd came up and began to ask Pilate to do for them as he always did.

verses.kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.modern: Pilate answered them, "Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

verses.kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.modern: He knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.

verses.kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.modern: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas to them instead.

verses.kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.modern: "What then do you want me to do with the man you call the King of the Jews?" Pilate asked.

verses.kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.modern: They shouted back, "Crucify Him!"

verses.kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.modern: "Why? What crime has He committed?" Pilate asked. They shouted even louder, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
verses.modern: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged and handed Him over to be crucified.

verses.kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.modern: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace — that is, the Praetorium — and called the whole company of soldiers together.

verses.kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
verses.modern: They clothed Him in purple and twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on Him.

verses.kjv: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.modern: They began to call out to Him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"

verses.kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
verses.modern: They struck His head with a staff and spit on Him. Falling on their knees, they mocked worship before Him.

verses.kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.modern: When they had finished mocking Him, they took off the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him out to crucify Him.

verses.kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
verses.modern: They forced a man named Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was coming in from the country, to carry His cross.

verses.kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
verses.modern: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha — which means "The Place of a Skull."

verses.kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
verses.modern: They offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.

verses.kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
verses.modern: When they crucified Him, they divided His clothes by casting lots to decide what each would get.

verses.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.modern: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.

verses.kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.modern: The written notice of the charge against Him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.modern: They crucified two robbers with Him, one on His right and one on His left.

verses.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
verses.modern: So the scripture was fulfilled which says, "And He was numbered with the transgressors."

verses.kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
verses.modern: Those who passed by hurled insults at Him, shaking their heads and saying, "So! You who would destroy the temple and build it in three days —"

verses.kjv: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
verses.modern: "Come down from the cross and save Yourself!"

verses.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.modern: In the same way the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves. "He saved others," they said, "but He cannot save Himself!"

verses.kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
verses.modern: "Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down from the cross now so that we may see and believe." Those who were crucified with Him also insulted Him.

verses.kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.modern: When the sixth hour came, darkness fell over the whole land until the ninth hour.

verses.kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.modern: At the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?" — which means, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"

verses.kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.modern: When some who stood by heard this, they said, "Listen, He is calling Elijah."

verses.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.modern: Someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He put it on a stick and offered it to Jesus to drink. "Let Him alone," He said. "Let us see whether Elijah will come to take him down."

verses.kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
verses.modern: Jesus cried out with a loud voice and gave up the spirit.

verses.kjv: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.modern: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

verses.kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verses.modern: When the centurion who stood facing him saw how he cried out and gave up the spirit, He said, "Truly this man was the Son of God."

verses.kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
verses.modern: There were also women watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.

verses.kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
verses.modern: These women had followed Jesus and served Him when He was in Galilee. Many other women who had come up with Him to Jerusalem were also there.

verses.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.modern: When evening came, because it was the Day of Preparation — the day before the Sabbath —

verses.kjv: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
verses.modern: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who was Himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
verses.modern: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead. He called the centurion and asked him if Jesus had been dead for some time.

verses.kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
verses.modern: When he found out from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.

verses.kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
verses.modern: Joseph bought fine linen. He took Jesus down from the cross, wrapped Him in the linen, and placed Him in a tomb cut out of rock. He rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.

verses.kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
verses.modern: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw where he was laid.

chapters.summary: Jesus is delivered to Pontius Pilate, who offers to release Him, but the crowd demands Barabbas. The soldiers mock Jesus, crown Him with thorns, and crucify Him at Golgotha. He cries out, gives up His spirit, and Joseph of Arimathaea buries Him in a tomb hewn from rock.

verses.kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.modern: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint Jesus.

verses.kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.modern: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.

verses.kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.modern: They were asking each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?"

verses.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.modern: When they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away — it was very large.

verses.kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.modern: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side. They were alarmed.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verses.modern: "Do not be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid Him."

verses.kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.modern: "But go and tell His disciples — and Peter — that he is going ahead of you into Galilee. You will see Him there, just as He told you."

verses.kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
verses.modern: They went out and fled from the tomb. Trembling and amazed, they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
verses.modern: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven demons.

verses.kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.modern: She went and told those who had been with Him, as they mourned and wept.

verses.kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.modern: When they heard that He was alive and had been seen by her, they did not believe it.

verses.kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.modern: After this, He appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.

verses.kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.modern: These two went back and told the rest, but they did not believe them either.

verses.kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
verses.modern: Later He appeared to the eleven as they were eating. He rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who had seen Him after He rose.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature."

verses.kjv: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.modern: "Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be damned."

verses.kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.modern: "These signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will cast out demons. They will speak in new tongues."

verses.kjv: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.modern: "They will pick up snakes with their hands. If they drink anything deadly, it will not harm them. They will lay their hands on the sick, and they will get well."

verses.kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.modern: After the Lord had spoken to them, He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

verses.kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
verses.modern: They went out and preached everywhere. The Lord worked with them and confirmed His word by the signs that followed. Amen.

chapters.summary: Three women come to the tomb at sunrise and find the stone rolled away and an angel who tells them Jesus has risen. The risen Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene, to two disciples on the road, and to the eleven, commissioning them to preach the gospel to every creature before ascending into heaven.
